body: Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) have recently moved from static workflows toward dynamically generated collaboration topologies. However, existing topology generation methods rely primarily on the parametric knowledge of large language models, with external search or retrieval used only as a reactive tool rather than an explicit determinant of collaboration structure. This leads to structure-knowledge misalignment, where systems exhibit redundant interactions or insufficient verification in knowledge-intensive tasks. We propose K-GAT (Knowledge-Guided Agent Topology Generator), a neuro-symbolic framework that formulates collaboration topology design as a knowledge-conditioned structure learning problem, integrating external evidence directly into autoregressive graph generation. Extensive experiments on knowledge-intensive benchmarks demonstrate K-GAT's efficiency and effectiveness: notably on the expert-level GPQA dataset, K-GAT outperforms the LLM-Debate baseline by a substantial margin of +15.7% in accuracy, while consuming less than half the computational tokens.
summaryZh: 针对多智能体系统（MAS）中现有拓扑生成方法主要依赖大模型参数化知识、导致结构与知识不对齐的问题，该研究提出了K-GAT（知识引导智能体拓扑生成器）。K-GAT采用神经符号学框架，将协作拓扑设计建模为知识条件化结构学习问题，把外部证据直接融入自回归图生成中。在 экспер特级GPQA数据集等知识密集型基准上的实验表明，K-GAT相比LLM-Debate基线准确率大幅提升了15.7%，同时消耗的计算代币不到一半。

glossary.explanationZh: 多智能体系统，由多个能够交互和协作的自主智能体组成的计算系统。
协作拓扑，指多智能体之间进行信息交互和任务分配的网络结构关系。
神经符号学框架，结合了神经网络的表示学习能力与符号逻辑的推理能力的方法。
自回归图生成，指通过逐步预测节点和边来构建图结构的技术方法。
结构-知识不对齐，指智能体协作架构与任务所需外部专业知识之间存在脱节的现象。
